fusions.name: Spiked Casing
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolted Shut
fusions.desc: A riveting blow deals 8 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and has a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Layered Shutters
fusions.desc: Closes a steel shutter over you that absorbs the next 20 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Maiden Plating
fusions.desc: Conjures spiked plate: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your maximum health rises by 8.
